_meta._note: Wave 6A4 — Frontier agentic benchmark backfill across BFCL v4, GAIA, OSWorld-Verified, Terminal-Bench 2.0. Strict primary-source attribution: every (model_id, benchmark_id, value) row is visible on the cited primary source page/CSV/PDF. Sources used: (1) Berkeley Gorilla BFCL v4 data_overall.csv (frontier rows for Opus/Sonnet/Haiku 4.5, Gemini 3 Pro Preview, GLM-4.6, Grok-4, Kimi K2 Instruct, GPT-5.2/5-mini/5-nano/4.1, o3, o4-mini, DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp, Gemini 2.5 Flash, Cohere Command A Reasoning, Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct-2507); (2) HAL Princeton GAIA leaderboard (HAL Generalist Agent rows for Haiku 4.5, DeepSeek R1, DeepSeek V3, o3, Gemini 2.0 Flash, GPT-4.1); (3) HAL Princeton USACO leaderboard (Gemini 2.0 Flash row); (4) anthropic.com/news/claude-sonnet-4-5 OSWorld disclosure (Sonnet 4.5 = 61.4%, Sonnet 4 = 42.2% in same comparison sentence); (5) anthropic.com/news/claude-haiku-4-5 (Haiku 4.5 Terminal-Bench 41.75% with 32K thinking budget). All BFCL rows use Overall Acc as the canonical headline metric, matching existing DB entries (microsoft/phi-4 28.79%, openai/gpt-5 59.2%). Function-Calling (FC) variant is the official rank-1 score where vendor publishes both FC and Prompt; Prompt variant noted only when no FC available (Gemini-3-Pro-Preview prompt rank #3 vs FC rank #7 — chose Prompt as it's the higher published Google figure on the leaderboard).
